title: Mobile Appraisal Application
description: A hybrid mobile solution enabling field appraisers to complete dynamic forms offline and synchronize data seamlessly when connectivity is restored.
overview_p1: This mobile application was developed for a professional appraisal company to streamline their field operations. The app enables appraisers to work in remote locations without internet connectivity while maintaining full functionality.
overview_p2: The solution leverages Angular with Capacitor to deliver a cross-platform mobile experience, implementing a robust offline-first architecture that guarantees data integrity and seamless synchronization.
overview_p3: Dynamic forms are generated using Formly, allowing the system to adapt to different types of appraisals without requiring app updates.
features: Offline-first architecture for seamless field work

challenges.title: Offline Data Management
challenges.description: Implemented robust local storage with SQLite to handle complex form data structures while maintaining data integrity.

challenges.title: Dynamic Form Rendering
challenges.description: Created a flexible form system using Formly that adapts to different appraisal types and requirements.

challenges.title: Cross-Platform Consistency
challenges.description: Ensured identical user experience across iOS and Android devices with platform-specific optimizations.
